title: Spanish Language – Level 02
overview: This elementary Spanish language course builds on Level 01 and develops learners’ ability to manage a wider range of familiar social, travel and routine workplace interactions. Participants consolidate present-tense accuracy, communicate about past events and future plans, expand their practical vocabulary, and strengthen listening, speaking, reading and writing through guided tasks and authentic scenarios.
audience: Learners who have completed Spanish Language – Level 01 or have equivalent foundational skills.
Professionals seeking greater confidence in routine interactions with Spanish speakers.
Travelers and individuals wishing to communicate more independently in everyday situations.
Learners preparing for the more complex communication tasks in Spanish Language – Level 03.
methodology: Instructor-led mini-lessons with demonstrations and supported communicative practice.
Pair work, information-gap tasks, simulations and practical role-plays.
Progressive listening and reading exercises using short contextualized materials.
Guided writing, pronunciation coaching, spaced vocabulary review and corrective feedback.
Frequent formative checks and an integrated final performance assessment.
competencies: Maintain connected conversations about everyday routines, experiences and plans.
Apply elementary grammar and core verb forms in familiar contexts.
Understand the main points of clear, short spoken and written messages.
Write organized short messages, descriptions and simple personal correspondence.
Use appropriate politeness, register and repair strategies when communication is difficult.
objectives: Describe daily life, people, locations and personal experiences in greater detail.
Narrate simple completed actions and discuss intentions and upcoming activities.
Ask for clarification, make arrangements and solve common practical problems.
Express preferences, comparisons, opinions and reasons using connected sentences.
Read short practical texts and compose coherent paragraphs and messages.
Demonstrate readiness to progress to Spanish Language – Level 03.

items.text: Revisiting greetings, introductions, routine questions and common responses.

outline.title: Present Tense: Regular and Irregular Verbs

items.text: Consolidating -ar, -er and -ir conjugations in meaningful sentences.

Writing a connected description of a daily schedule.

items.text: Forming regular preterite verbs to describe completed actions.
